headline: Palantine Berm Erupts as Callahan Passage Front Fractures Anew
war_summary: Since the previous edition, severe fighting has reignited across several dormant sectors while the northern meat-grinder grinds on. In the Weathered Expanse, relentless skirmishing generated five base transitions within two hours and claimed nearly 3,700 casualties, shifting regional control to five Colonial bases, two Warden redoubts, and two neutral zones. Farther west, Callahan's Passage saw Colonials claw back two strongholds despite enduring another massive toll of 3,700 fallen across both factions. Palantine Berm, quieted in earlier dispatches, has abruptly flared to life with seven rapid base exchanges in the last two hours, though Warden troops retain full hold of all seven garrisons. A sharp flare-up also struck Stonecradle, producing five base shifts and leaving Colonials in control of eight positions to the Wardens' one. Along the Nevish Line, heavy fighting cost over 2,200 men as Wardens shored up battered lines to hold seven bases against a lone Colonial outpost. Meanwhile, front-line exchanges on the Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand have paused over the past two hours, leaving the Shelf tilted eight to one in Colonial favor.
